t: This release adds Smithy RPC v2 CBOR as an additional protocol alongside the existing AWS JSON 1.1. The SDK will prioritize its most performant protocol.
Added License Arn as a new optional filter for GetEntitlements and LicenseArn field in each entitlement in the response.
